methodology: To perform the analysis, I systematically decomposed the provided information into atomic units by identifying distinct requirements, features, and behaviors described in each text. Each unit was defined to be independent, specific, and implementable.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Create a module implementing 16 D flip-flops forming a 16-bit register.
The byte-enable inputs determine whether the upper byte (d[15:8]) or lower byte (d[7:0]) of the register is written to during a clock cycle.
The resetn signal is a synchronous, active-low reset.
All flip-flops are triggered on the positive edge of the clk signal.
spec_atomic_units: The module defines a 16-bit register with selective byte writing capability.
The inputs include clk, resetn, byteena[1:0], and d[15:0].
The output is q[15:0], reflecting the current state of the register.
The byte-enable signals determine which bytes of the register are updated during a clock cycle.
The resetn signal initializes the register to a known state when asserted.
All flip-flops are triggered on the positive edge of the clk signal.
